title: High-Protein Chocolate Peanut Butter Mousse
description: This high-protein chocolate peanut butter mousse delivers 30 grams of protein per serving and takes just 10 minutes to prepare. Blended Greek yogurt, chocolate protein powder, and real peanut butter create a thick, silky snack.
steps: In a medium mixing bowl, combine the chilled nonfat Greek yogurt, chocolate whey protein powder, creamy peanut butter, sifted cocoa powder, maple syrup, almond milk, vanilla extract, and fine sea salt.
Vigorously whisk by hand (or beat with an electric hand mixer on low speed) for 1 minute until the mixture is completely smooth, creamy, and free of powder lumps.
Spoon the mixture into 2 small serving jars, cover, and place in the refrigerator at 38°F (3°C) for at least 15 minutes until chilled and set enough to hold its shape on a spoon.
tips: Using casein or a whey-casein blend yields an even thicker, pudding-like consistency after chilling.
If the mixture is too thick to blend initially, add an extra tablespoon of almond milk.
Garnish with cacao nibs or crushed roasted peanuts right before serving for extra crunch.
storage: Store covered in airtight glass jars in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

video_script.hook: Whip up 30 grams of protein with this chocolate peanut butter mousse.
steps_short: Add Greek yogurt, chocolate protein powder, and peanut butter to a blender.
Pour in maple syrup, cocoa powder, almond milk, vanilla, and salt.
Blend on medium-high for two minutes until silky smooth.
Spoon into ramekins and chill fifteen minutes until thick.

issues: Blending nonfat Greek yogurt in a high-speed blender for 1 to 2 minutes shears the protein gel network of the yogurt, causing it to turn thin and watery rather than maintaining a thick mousse texture. Whisking the ingredients in a mixing bowl or using a hand mixer preserves the yogurt's body while smoothly incorporating the powders.
